message.content: Based on the conversation, LiHua finds several aspects of Black Myth: Wukong immersive. Specifically, she mentions enjoying the exploration aspect, finding new areas and secrets within the game. Additionally, she describes the combat style as being immersive and how it blends with the storyline. LiHua also notes that the first time she faced a tricky boss battle, she was "on the edge of her seat," indicating that the intensity and challenge of the boss battles contribute to the game's immersion. Furthermore, the visuals are described as "stunning," suggesting that the visual aspects of the game are highly immersive as well. Overall, LiHua seems to appreciate multiple facets of the game, highlighting different components that draw her in and create an engaging experience.
